title: Ballina Upper, Ballymurn, Co Wexford, Y21EH02
seoTitle: Ballina Upper, Ballymurn, Co Wexford, Y21EH02
description:
Offers in Excess of €449,000.


A large bright spacious 4 bedroom detached bungalow with fabulous living space that is ready to move into straight away.

The property is situated within a six minute drive from the pretty village of Ballymurn with its pub, national school, church and garage with well stocked shop. Both Wexford Town and Enniscorthy are within a fifteen minute drive and the N11 to Dublin is within east access.

Accommodation includes a large living room, super kitchen/dining, large sunroom, utility room, 4 bedrooms (main ensuite) a family bathroom and a large detached garage.
The gardens are mature, well planted and easily managed.
If you are looking for "a ready to move into", family home with generous living accommodation,  "Le Cappelle" might be the property for you.

Please ring Abbie or MJ to book in a viewing.
